Preserve key visual traits such as facial structure and overall proportions, while allowing small natural variations typical of real photography. The generated subject should clearly resemble the reference while remaining a natural photographic interpretation.
A hyper-realistic, ultra-sharp photograph taken on a modern iPhone 15 Pro, characterized by its digital clarity and bright HDR rendering. The subject is captured in a dynamic low-angle pose, leaning forward toward the lens while holding a small glass bottle with a yellow label containing a light-colored liquid. The person wears a dark-toned summer sundress featuring a delicate pattern of small white and yellow daisies and thin spaghetti straps, complemented by a minimalist silver pendant necklace. The hair is styled in long, voluminous dark waves swept over one shoulder and adorned with a white floral accessory. The composition is framed by vibrant green palm fronds against a vast, cloudless, bright blue sky, with the entire scene rendered in sharp focus. The lighting is bright and even, typical of modern smartphone photography, lifting all shadows to reveal realistic, dewy skin textures with visible pores. A powerful and authentic motion blur effect is applied to the hand holding the bottle to create a sense of candid, energetic action, while the entire image incorporates a low-fidelity compression look with authentic early digital artifacts and slight pixelation. The makeup aesthetic features a soft coral-toned blush, subtle dark eyeliner techniques, and a soft-edged reddish-pink lip color with a satin finish.

title: 不可能的倒影 - 平行现实水洼
description: 这是一个为 Nano Banana 2 设计的超详细提示词，旨在创作一张图片：街道上的大水洼倒映出的不是现实世界，而是一个完全不同的平行幻想世界。提示词详细说明了现实世界与倒影中幻想世界的细节、氛围及技术要求。
content:
Create a street scene where a large rain puddle on a cobblestone street shows a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT world in its reflection. The real world and reflected world are different realities.

REAL WORLD (top half):
- A quiet modern European cobblestone street on a grey overcast day
- A person in a {argument name="real world coat color" default="grey"} coat walking with an umbrella
- Modern buildings, parked cars, a bicycle
- Bare winter trees
- Muted, desaturated, cold — typical rainy Tuesday afternoon

PUDDLE REFLECTION (bottom half — inverted):
- Instead of reflecting the real world above, the puddle shows a DIFFERENT version:
- The same street but in a parallel fantasy universe: the buildings are covered in lush tropical vegetation, the trees are in full cherry blossom bloom
- The grey-coated person's reflection shows them in flowing colorful robes
- The parked car's reflection is a horse-drawn carriage
- The sky in the reflection is a stunning sunset with aurora borealis
- Flying whales visible in the reflected sky
- The cobblestones in the reflection are made of gold

TECHNICAL:
- The puddle is large enough to fill the bottom 45% of the frame
- The real world fills the top 55%
- The reflection is perfectly inverted (as puddle reflections are) but shows this alternate reality
- Some ripples in the puddle distort the fantasy world slightly — proving it's a water surface
- The edges where puddle meets cobblestone show the transition between worlds
- Rain drops hitting the puddle surface create small circular ripples that briefly distort the fantasy world

STYLE: The real world is photorealistic, muted, cold. The reflected world is vivid, warm, magical — the contrast between the two realities is the entire point. Shot at low angle (camera nearly on the ground) to maximize the puddle reflection. Slightly wide angle (24mm equivalent). 8K detail in both worlds.
translatedContent:
创建一个街道场景，其中鹅卵石路面上的大雨洼在倒影中呈现出一个“完全不同”的世界。现实世界与倒影世界是两个不同的维度。

现实世界（上半部分）：
- 一个阴天、安静的现代欧洲鹅卵石街道
- 一个穿着 {argument name="real world coat color" default="灰色"} 外套的人撑着伞走过
- 现代建筑、停放的汽车、一辆自行车
- 光秃秃的冬季树木
- 色调柔和、低饱和度、寒冷——典型的阴雨周二下午

水洼倒影（下半部分——倒置）：
- 水洼倒映的不是上方的现实世界，而是另一个版本：
- 同一条街道，但处于平行幻想宇宙中：建筑覆盖着茂盛的热带植被，树木开满了樱花
- 穿着灰色外套的人在倒影中身着飘逸的彩色长袍
- 停放的汽车在倒影中变成了马车
- 倒影中的天空是令人惊叹的日落景象，伴有极光
- 倒影的天空中可以看到飞行的鲸鱼
- 倒影中的鹅卵石由黄金制成

技术要求：
- 水洼足够大，占据画面底部 45% 的区域
- 现实世界占据顶部 55% 的区域
- 倒影呈现完美的倒置效果（如水洼倒影所示），但展现的是这个平行现实

content: Create a premium smartphone wallpaper in vertical 9:16 format, Japanese minimal editorial aesthetic, quiet and refined, inspired by modern notebook-grid design and clean infographic illustration. Background: warm off-white paper texture with a very subtle light gray square grid across the whole canvas, soft natural paper feel, elegant and minimal, bright but not stark white. Color palette: off-white, soft gray, black, muted sage green only, low-saturation, elegant contrast, avoid loud neon colors. Style direction: minimal, premium, calm, smart, editorial, Japanese taste, beautiful negative space, clean geometry, subtle stationery mood, slightly futuristic but warm, suitable as a stylish wallpaper for adults. Output quality: ultra clean composition, high clarity, refine

"Create a highly detailed, cinematic, photorealistic lifestyle photograph of {argument name="subject" default="Millie Bobby Brown"} at an outdoor festival during early evening. She has long, slightly wavy hair and a playful expression, smiling with her teeth visible while looking back over her right shoulder directly at the camera. Her makeup is light and natural. She is wearing sunglasses resting on top of her head, large teal-colored drop-shaped earrings, and a bright yellow festival wristband on her right wrist.

She has a slim, fit body and is dressed in a light greenish-gray cropped short-sleeve t-shirt with a faded print on the front, paired with light blue ripped denim cut-off shorts. On her feet, she wears classic black high-top canvas sneakers with white laces, a white toe cap, and white soles.

Her pose is dynamic and confident: she is standing with her back facing the camera, her torso twisted as she looks over her right shoulder. Her right arm is slightly raised with a relaxed hand near her waist, while her left arm hangs naturally. Her weight is mostly on her extended left leg, with her right leg slightly bent, creating a casual and energetic posture.

The setting is a lively outdoor festival, resembling an amusement park. In the background, there is a large Ferris wheel illuminated with neon pink and white lights along its spokes and rim. Blurred figures of people walking can be seen in the background, and the ground appears dark, like a temporary paved surface.

The lighting combines soft dusk light with strong, cool artificial ambient light coming from the Ferris wheel. The neon lights create a glowing rim light around her hair, shoulders, and silhouette, while a soft front fill light clearly illuminates her face and body.

The overall mood is vibrant, youthful, energetic, and cinematic, capturing the lively atmosphere of a summer festival. The color palette emphasizes neon pink, bright white, light denim blue, greenish-gray, black, and soft pink tones.

The image should be captured in a portrait orientation (9:16), using a slightly low camera angle and a tight framing (medium close-up or American shot), with the subject occupying almost the entire frame. Use a telephoto lens between 85mm and 135mm to compress perspective and emphasize the subject, with a shallow depth of field to keep her extremely sharp while the background remains softly blurred with bokeh. The final result should be highly detailed, with sharp focus on the subject, vibrant and contrasting colors, professional lighting, and 8K resolution quality."

"创作一张高细节、电影感、照片级真实感的生活化照片，主角是 {argument name="subject" default="Millie Bobby Brown"}，场景设定在傍晚的户外节日现场。她留着微卷的长发，表情俏皮，露齿微笑，正回头看向右肩，直视镜头。妆容清透自然。她头顶架着一副太阳镜，佩戴着硕大的青色水滴状耳环，右手腕戴着亮黄色的节日手环。

光线结合了柔和的黄昏光和来自摩天轮的强烈冷色调人工环境光。霓虹灯在她的头发、肩膀和轮廓周围营造出明亮的轮廓光，而柔和的前补光则清晰地照亮了她的面部和身体。

整体氛围充满活力、青春、动感且具有电影质感，捕捉到了夏季节日的热闹气息。色彩基调强调霓虹粉、亮白、浅牛仔蓝、灰绿、黑色和柔粉色调。

content:
Convert this image into a soft, handcrafted paper-cut layered illustration style, inspired by papercraft diorama aesthetics. Use smooth rounded shapes, simplified cute character proportions, and minimal facial details (dot eyes, blush cheeks) to create a warm, charming look. Apply stacked paper layers with visible depth, subtle shadows between layers, and clean cut edges that resemble laser-cut cardstock. 
Add a distinct white outer outline layer surrounding each main character, resembling a thick sticker border or white cut-paper backing, clearly separating the characters from the background. This white layer should feel like an intentional paper layer, not a glow.

Use a pastel color palette with muted blues, greens, and warm neutrals, balanced and calming.

Lighting should feel soft, diffused, and even, enhancing the dimensional paper layers without harsh contrast. Textures should appear matte and tactile, like thick art paper or craft foam.

Overall mood: cozy, wholesome, gentle, and

storybook-like, with a playful yet polished handcrafted feel suitable for modern illustration, children's books, or decorative art.
translatedContent:
将此图像转换为柔和的手工剪纸分层插画风格，灵感源自纸艺立体模型美学。使用圆润平滑的形状、简化可爱的角色比例以及极简的面部细节（豆豆眼、腮红），营造出温暖迷人的视觉效果。应用堆叠的纸张图层，展现明显的深度感、层与层之间细微的阴影，以及类似激光切割卡纸的干净边缘。

在每个主体人物周围添加一层清晰的白色外轮廓，类似于厚实的贴纸边框或白色剪纸衬底，使人物与背景清晰分离。这层白色轮廓应呈现出刻意的纸张质感，而非发光效果。

使用柔和的配色方案，搭配低饱和度的蓝色、绿色和暖中性色，整体平衡且宁静。

光线应柔和、漫射且均匀，在不产生强烈对比的情况下增强纸张的立体感。纹理应呈现哑光且具有触感的效果，如同厚实的艺术纸或手工泡沫板。

整体氛围：舒适、治愈、温柔且富有故事感，兼具俏皮与精致的手工质感，适用于现代插画、儿童绘本或装饰艺术。

content: Prompt: Preserve their real facial features, bone structure, eye shape, nose shape, lips, and overall facial identity - the face must clearly match the uploaded person. Do not alter age, ethnicity, or facial proportions. Reference image required, face identity lock. A close-up portrait of an uploaded person subject, their torso and head enveloped in massive, voluminous, sculptural fabric folds. The subject faces forward, head tilted slightly downward, looking up directly into the lens with a direct gaze, relaxed jaw, subtly parted lips, and slight tension in lower eyelids. They are surrounded and partially obscured by sweeping layers of structural fabric, which is stiff yet lightweight, intensely pleated and crinkled, holding structural arches, deep crevices, and sweeping folds around them. A few loose strands of hair escape the fabric wrap, resting flat against the cheek. Makeup features a matte, unreflective skin texture. The setting is a minimalist studio with a plain off-white background. The face is framed within an aperture of fabric, offset slightly to the right with negative space on the left. The camera is at eye-level, creating an architectural framing using textile volumes. Soft, directional studio light comes from camera-left, creating gradient shadows within the fabric crevices and gentle modeling on the right side of the face. The mood is sculptural, serene, and editorial. The color palette features deep {argument name="fabric color" default="emerald green"} for the fabric, off-white for the background, and natural skin tones, with high color contrast between the green fabric and light background, and soft tonal contrast on the face. Photographed with a medium format digital camera and an 85mm lens at f/5.6. The face and foreground fabric are sharply in focus, with slight blurring on the furthest background folds. The style is avant-garde editorial portraiture, photorealistic, with minimal film grain. No CGI, no cartoon, no Al glow. Full color.

all duplicates

title: Elizabeth Olsen：田园风高级定制微距肖像
description: 这是一个为 Gemini Nano Banana Pro 设计的极具针对性且细节丰富的提示词，旨在创作一张酷似 Elizabeth Olsen 的超写实前卫微距肖像。主体身着一件完全由生玉米棒和玉米粒制成的不可思议的高级定制服装，强调极致的纹理细节、精准的美学布光以及锐利的眼神交流，并采用模拟胶片质感进行渲染。
content: The Intricate Macro Portrait: An extreme close-up shot of The Protagonist, exuding 'The Piercing Minimalist' energy with absolute, unblinking eye contact and a high-intensity stoic expression. The subject is engulfed in an impossible, avant-garde haute couture garment and wide-brimmed headpiece constructed entirely of raw, freshly husked ears of yellow corn and meticulously aligned individual kernels. The heavy, organic, surreal armor wraps tightly around the neck and frames the face, treated as a high-budget physical practical effect. Shot in a darkened botanical atelier against a deep, matte-black velvet backdrop to eliminate distractions. The face is fully illuminated with flawless Beauty Lighting—a large overhead beauty dish creates perfect catchlights in the sharply focused irises, while balancing a soft fill that highlights microscopic skin pores and the glistening, waxy texture of the corn kernels. Captured on a Hasselblad H6D-100c with a 120mm Macro lens shot at f/2.8, ensuring a razor-thin depth of field that makes the organic filaments, silks, and kernel reflections pop against a softly blurred, dark void. Kodak Portra 160 film stock emulation, authentic analog grain, profound tactile realism, completely devoid of neon or digital illustration artifacts. Frame: Portrait (4:5), extreme close-up, tightly framing the subject's face completely surrounded by the intricate organic corn textures. Center-weighted symmetry, drawing the viewer instantly to the eyes and the complex structural geometry of the garment. Directly at eye-level, highly intimate and confrontational. Subject: The Protagonist, serving as a universal fine-art archetype. Ageless, ethereal high-fashion model. Female with flawless but textured natural skin, neutral makeup, sharp jawline enveloped by the cowl. Hair completely concealed beneath the heavy, structural kernel headpiece. Only the face and a fraction of the neck are visible, bearing the physical weight of the surreal garment. Expression: Absolute stoicism, high-intensity neutral gaze, projecting quiet dominance. Wardrobe: Massive sculptural cowl neck and shoulder piece made from raw, whole ears of yellow corn stacked and woven densely together, complete with organic silk filaments. Vibrant, organic harvest yellow with pale earthy undertones. Suffocatingly tight, heavy, and architecturally structured around the chin and neck. Wide-brimmed domed hat in monochromatic golden yellow made from thousands of perfectly aligned, individual raw corn kernels acting as geometric beads. Surrealist Botanical Haute Couture style. Environment: A highly controlled, darkened botanical photography Atelier. Light-absorbing matte-black velvet backdrop directly behind the subject. Extremely shallow depth; the world drops off immediately into a pure black void behind the subject. Still, cool, devoid of ambient light, giving full control to the studio strobes. Lighting: Large overhead beauty dish with a diffusion sock (Paramount/Butterfly lighting) to evenly illuminate the face. Subtle silver reflector positioned under the chin to soften deep shadows cast by the heavy organic cowl. Barely perceptible cool edge light to separate the outer silhouette of the corn hat from the black background. Rich, deep, but retaining micro-contrast within the granular textures of the corn. 5500K (Daylight balanced to ensure accurate, true-to-life organic yellows and skin tones). Camera: Medium Format Macro Prime lens at 120mm, aperture f/2.8. Pin-sharp lock on the irises and the absolute nearest corn kernels framing the cheeks. Medium Format Digital simulating 120 film. Zero spatial compression, highly accurate true-to-life facial proportions. Post-processing: High color fidelity, rich organic saturation of yellows against absolute true blacks. High dynamic range with a distinct cinematic film curve, protecting highlights on the waxy corn. Pronounced analog film grain (Kodak Portra 160), emphasizing physical skin pores and plant cell structures. Zero artificial sharpening; relying entirely on the pristine optical clarity of the macro lens. Extremely subtle edge fringing in the deep out-of-focus areas to mimic vintage glass. Negative specifications: No neon lights. No digital 3D rendering or CGI look. No cartoonish or animated elements. No full body shots. No smiling or emotive facial contortions. No flat lighting. No artificial plastics or synthetic fabrics. No wide-angle distortion.
translatedContent: 精致的微距肖像：一张主角的极度特写镜头，散发着“锐利极简主义”的气息，眼神绝对专注且不眨眼，表情呈现出高强度的冷峻感。主体被包裹在一件不可思议的前卫高级定制服装和宽檐头饰中，这些服饰完全由新鲜剥皮的黄玉米棒和精心排列的独立玉米粒构成。沉重、有机且超现实的“盔甲”紧紧包裹着颈部并衬托着面部，呈现出高预算的物理实拍效果。在昏暗的植物摄影工作室中拍摄，背景为深哑光黑色天鹅绒，以消除干扰。面部被完美的美学布光（Beauty Lighting）完全照亮——上方的大型美容碟（beauty dish）在焦点锐利的虹膜中创造出完美的眼神光，同时平衡了柔和的补光，突显了微小的皮肤毛孔以及玉米粒闪烁的蜡质纹理。使用 Hasselblad H6D-100c 搭配 120mm 微距镜头，光圈 f/2.8 拍摄，确保了极浅的景深，使有机纤维、玉米须和玉米粒的反光在柔和模糊的黑暗虚空中脱颖而出。模拟 Kodak Portra 160 胶片质感，具有真实的模拟颗粒感和深刻的触觉写实感，完全没有任何霓虹灯或数字插画的痕迹。构图：肖像（4:5），极度特写，紧凑地框住主体面部，周围环绕着复杂的有机玉米纹理。中心对称，瞬间将观众的注意力吸引到眼睛和服装复杂的结构几何形状上。视线平齐，极具亲密感和对抗性。主体：主角，作为一种通用的艺术原型。年龄成谜、空灵的高级时装模特。女性，拥有完美但具有纹理的天然皮肤、中性妆容，下颌线锐利，被头罩包裹。头发完全隐藏在沉重的结构化玉米粒头饰下。仅露出面部和一小部分颈部，承载着超现实服装的物理重量。表情：绝对的冷峻，高强度的中性凝视，投射出一种安静的统治力。服装：巨大的雕塑感高领和肩部装饰，由生整玉米棒堆叠并紧密编织而成，配有有机的玉米须。充满活力的有机丰收黄，带有淡淡的泥土色调。在下巴和颈部周围紧绷、沉重且具有建筑结构感。单色金黄色的宽檐圆顶帽，由数千颗排列整齐的独立生玉米粒作为几何珠子制成。超现实主义植物高级定制风格。环境：高度受控的昏暗植物摄影工作室。主体后方为吸光的哑光黑色天鹅绒背景。景深极浅；主体后方的世界立即坠入纯黑色的虚空。静谧、凉爽，没有任何环境光，完全由摄影棚闪光灯控制。布光：上方大型美容碟配柔光罩（Paramount/Butterfly 布光），均匀照亮面部。下巴下方放置细微的银色反光板，以柔化沉重的有机头罩投下的深阴影。几乎察觉不到的冷色轮廓光，将玉米帽的外轮廓与黑色背景分离。色彩丰富、深邃，但在玉米的颗粒纹理中保留了微对比度。5500K（日光平衡，确保准确、真实的有机黄色和肤色）。相机：中画幅微距定焦镜头，120mm，光圈 f/2.8。焦点精准锁定在虹膜和勾勒脸颊的最前方玉米粒上。中画幅数码模拟 120 胶片。零空间压缩，面部比例高度准确且真实。后期处理：高色彩保真度，黄色在绝对纯黑背景下呈现出丰富的有机饱和度。高动态范围，带有独特的电影胶片曲线，保护蜡质玉米上的高光。明显的模拟胶片颗粒（Kodak Portra 160），强调物理皮肤毛孔和植物细胞结构。零人工锐化；完全依赖微距镜头原始的光学清晰度。深处失焦区域有极细微的边缘色散，以模仿复古镜头效果。负面要求：无霓虹灯。无数字 3D 渲染或 CGI 感。无卡通或动画元素。无全身照。无微笑或夸张的面部表情。无平光。无人工塑料或合成纤维。无广角畸变。

A candid street photography shot of two young Asian adults standing in front of a small Southeast Asian street food stall. The stall is packed with colorful menu boards and food photos, featuring dishes like {argument name="dishes" default="nasi goreng and ayam penyet"}, with prices in Indonesian rupiah. The signage is slightly worn and layered, giving a busy, authentic hawker-style atmosphere.
In the foreground, a young woman stands facing slightly to the right, looking off-camera with a neutral, calm expression. She has straight black shoulder-length hair, wears a black baseball cap and large over-ear headphones, and is dressed in a black, white, and red esports-style jersey with bold graphics and text. Her hands are casually in her pockets, posture relaxed.
Behind her, slightly leaning forward, is a young man with short dark hair and glasses. He wears a similar black and red esports jersey and light blue jeans. He is positioned slightly to her left and is looking at her with a subtle, curious expression, creating a natural candid moment.
Lighting is soft daylight, slightly overcast, with natural shadows. The composition feels spontaneous and documentary-style, with a sharp focus on the subjects and a richly detailed, slightly cluttered background. Colors are vibrant but realistic, emphasizing the reds, yellows, and food imagery from the stall.

title: 参考角色姿势网格研究提示词
description: 这是一份为 nano banana 编写的详细提示词，旨在生成 2x3 网格视角的参考角色研究图，通过从极远景到极特写的六个特定分镜，专注于保持角色的一致性并根据镜头距离调整姿势。
content:
16:9 landscape, 2x3 grid perspective study of the reference character on a solid off-white background. 6 panels in strict order: 1. Extreme Wide (silhouette focus), 2. Full Body (dynamic pose), 3. Waist-Up (torso twist), 4. Bust Shot (strong posture), 5. Face Close-Up (expression), 6. Extreme Close-Up (facial details/eyes).
- Consistency: Maintain identical facial structure, hair, and proportions across all panels.
- Posing: Tailor gestures to camera distance—broad movements for wide shots, subtle nuances for close-ups.
- Aesthetic: Consistent lighting and art style; no borders, text, or background environments.
translatedContent:
16:9 横屏，参考角色在纯米白色背景下的 2x3 网格视角研究。按严格顺序排列的 6 个分镜：1. 极远景（侧重剪影），2. 全身（动态姿势），3. 腰部以上（躯干扭转），4. 半身像（强力姿态），5. 面部特写（表情），6. 极特写（面部细节/眼睛）。
- 一致性：在所有分镜中保持完全相同的面部结构、发型和比例。
- 姿势：根据镜头距离调整动作——远景使用大幅度动作，特写使用细腻的表情变化。
- 美学：统一的光影和艺术风格；无边框、无文字、无背景环境。

She has one silver high-heeled sandal on her left foot, which is extended forward, while the other sandal is on her right foot. The background shows a modern staircase with dark wood and black metal railings. Bright, even lighting accentuates the smooth texture of her skin and the reflective quality of the marble counter."

"A young woman with long wavy red hair and fair skin is sitting on a white marble countertop, dressed in a sleeveless red dress that fits closely to her figure. She wears silver high-heeled sandals with thin straps and ankle cuffs on both feet. One leg is bent with the knee raised while the other is extended, and her hands rest casually on her leg and the counter for support. She looks at the camera with a gentle smile and slightly tilted head. The background consists of a dark staircase with black railings in a contemporary home setting. Soft professional lighting creates attractive highlights on her skin and the shiny marble surface."

The edges of the light must be sharp and dramatic. 
All areas outside the spotlight should fall quickly into deep darkness

Not soft lighting.
Hair: long dark hair with some strands falling over the face. The lower parts of the hair should fade into the shadows.
Pose: one hand raised gently to the lips in a shy, hesitant gesture. 
Eyes looking directly at the camera with a mysterious mood.
Clothing: black long-sleeve knit sweater; 
the sweater and body should mostly disappear into the darkness with minimal detail.
Overall tone: dark, moody, dramatic, mysterious. 
High-contrast only in the lit portion of the face. 
Everything outside the spotlight should be nearly invisible.

生成一张超写实动漫风格的女性角色人像，背景为纯黑色。

title: Ghormeh Sabzi 的中世纪祭坛画展示
description: 这是一个复杂的多面板提示词，旨在将国际美食（Ghormeh Sabzi）呈现为中世纪祭坛画。它详细说明了三个面板的结构，要求包含食材标本、3D 立体透视模型以及以 3D 设计师玩具风格呈现的烹饪步骤，所有内容均置于博物馆展览场景中。
content:
<instruction> Input A is a famous dish (photo or dish name). Analyze the dish's ingredient taxonomy, preparation methodology, cultural preparation setting, and historical documentation style.
Optional Input B is a style reference (3d mod designer toy luxury product packaging).  
Goal: Three-panel folding display (12" tall, 36" wide when open) structured like a medieval altarpiece, with each panel revealing different aspects of the dish's story through museum-quality presentation.
Rules:
Left panel: 15-20 ingredients mounted as specimens in tiny bottles with handwritten Latin/scientific labels
Center panel: 3D pop-up kitchen diorama with cultural figure preparing dish, architectural elements from origin region
Right panel: 6-8 precise preparation steps as 3D mod designer toy style
Closes into protective case with magnetic closure and embossed exterior
Exterior: ornate typography with dish name in gold foil
Small drawer at base containing actual spice sample or "secret ingredient"
Color palette drawn from traditional pottery/textiles of origin culture
Include tiny rolled "scroll" with full recipe in calligraphy
Output: ONE image, 16:9 showing triptych fully opened, shot straight-on, museum exhibition lighting </instruction>

可选输入 B 为风格参考（3D 建模设计师玩具、奢侈品包装）。

content: A hyper-realistic, cinematic macro photograph, vertical composition (9:16 aspect ratio). At the center of the frame is a single, large, perfect pineapple, standing upright with its full crown of vibrant green leaves, in a deep golden-yellow, viscous pool of pineapple juice. This central pineapple is very lightly and subtly dusted with fine pink powder (e.g., pitaya powder or pink confectioner's sugar), a minimal dusting especially around its leafy crown and textured skin, and is slick with intricate, visible condensation water droplets. Delicate, wispy white steam rises from the top and around the pineapple's leafy crown, creating a dramatic interaction with the dark, moody, textured background. The pineapple juice pool is set on a dark, textured slate surface. Around the pool, a natural, textured frame is created by scattered smaller, cut pineapple chunks and slices, delicate pink flowers, and additional scattered pink powder. All these elements surround the central pineapple. The lighting is dramatic and sidelit, precisely highlighting every single scale of the pineapple, leaf edge, water droplet, and the subtle, minimal trace of pink powder, and smoke tendril. The entire scene has a strong sense of depth and cinematic drama, tightly focused on the central pineapple.
